moments.text: Grey-scale infrared view looking down at farmland: fields, a canal, tree lines and walled compounds. Round white patches dot the fields.
The sensor zooms in and pans steadily across the fields; the white patches move along with the ground.
After a white flash, a much closer view: fields, tree lines and buildings slide past as the sensor swings, and bright white oval patches pass through the frame.
An elongated bright white blob enters at the lower left and slides up to the top of the frame in about 1 s, faster than the ground.
The view zooms far out: a wide grid of fields and compounds dotted with many small white spots.
A steady closer view of two fields split by a dark diagonal ditch.
The view settles on a square walled enclosure in smooth grey ground.

notes: Mid-grey pillarbox bars on both sides are not cropped (cropdetect only removes black).
